name: Basketball
headline: circumference
subtitle: Size 7 ball used in men's competitions
description: A basketball is an inflated rubber or leather ball with a pebbled surface. FIBA, the world governing body, requires a size 7 ball for all men's competitions, measuring 750 to 770 mm around and weighing 580 to 620 g. Women's games use a slightly smaller size 6 ball.

measures.label: Circumference
measures.note: FIBA tolerance for a size 7 ball (men's competitions)

measures.label: Weight
measures.note: FIBA tolerance for a size 7 ball

facts.text: FIBA's size 6 ball for women's competitions is 715-730 mm around and weighs 510-550 g.
Dropped from about 1,800 mm, a FIBA ball must bounce back to between 1,035 and 1,085 mm.

sources.title: Official Basketball Rules 2024: Basketball Equipment (Table 1, basketball circumference and weight tolerances)
Official 2025-26 NBA Playing Rules (Rule No. 1, Section II Equipment)

caveats: The NBA's 2025-26 Playing Rules only require an officially approved NBA ball and give no circumference or weight, so FIBA's size 7 figures are used.
The rules give circumference, not diameter; any diameter shown is calculated from it.
